fusions.name: Grapeshot Round
fusions.desc: Fires a round of grapeshot that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets, then bursts for 50% of that on every enemy within 2 tiles. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Ramming Course
fusions.desc: Charges up to 8 tiles down the deck and rams the target for 20 damage, leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. You heal for 15% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Easy Swell
fusions.desc: Restores 4 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Provisioned Voyage
fusions.desc: As you cover ground, you heal for 20% of all damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
